newsitem.title: USA: Aluminum orders rise 16.7 pct in Jan-June -Spector.
newsitem.headline: Aluminum orders rise 16.7 pct in Jan-June -Spector.

text.p: Aluminum orders in the United States rose 16.7 percent in January through June compared with the first half of last year, industry analyst Stewart Spector said.
Bookings in June also rose 16.7 percent from June 1996.

"It was also evident in June that end-users were still working with their suppliers on the basis of just in time delivery," Spector said. "With LME ingot prices stuck in a narrow trading range, consumers do not feel any pressure to price hedge, or add any safety stocks."
With a good economy, the odds favor a continuation of the present strong order trend in the current quarter, Spector said.
June can sheet releases were 20 percent above the comparable month last year, and year-to-date were ahead by 4.4 percent.
Non-can sheet bookings in June were 14.5 percent above June 1996, with first half 1997 bookings 21.5 percent ahead of the same period last year, Spector said.
